services.desc: CHL FAcT Team - James Tutte, Heather Fenn, Payton Boswell-Pearson and Jude Berard (missing from picture - Bryan Eaton) Canadian Helicopters Limited (CHL) today announced a 25-year commitment to Canada’s Future Aircrew Training (FAcT) program through its contract with SkyAlyne, a joint venture between CAE and KF Aerospace. Under the agreement, CHL will deliver maintenance services for the modernized fleet of CT-153 Juno (Airbus H135) helicopters along with academic and in-flight instruction to the next generation of Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) aircrew.
